title: Trace
description: A complete trace representing one logical request or workflow, composed of one or more Spans.

trace_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this trace.

name.description: Human-readable name for the trace (typically the root span name).

start_time_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the trace started (earliest span start).

end_time_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the trace ended (latest span end).

duration_ms.description: Total duration of the trace in milliseconds.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier, used for multi-tenant isolation.

span_count.description: Total number of spans in this trace.

has_error.description: True if any span in this trace recorded an error.

total_cost_usd.description: Sum of cost_usd across all spans in this trace.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this trace record.
